weekly_variant_generation_note: Generate additional prompts by combining subject + one axis value at a time (e.g. subject x sector, subject x location) — never stack more than 2 axes per prompt, to keep each prompt a natural buyer question rather than an artificial keyword string. Target ~40-60 prompts/week, run once, not daily (cost/time control).
